diagnosis: Customer is asking about the retirement timeline for the /v1/reporting endpoints used by their dashboard. KB-0007 confirms v1 stops accepting traffic on 2026-11-01, with v2 as the migration target returning the same fields under a paginated envelope. No account-specific blockers; standard informational response applies.
reply: Thanks for checking in on this. The v1 reporting endpoints are being retired: they will stop accepting traffic on 2026-11-01. We recommend migrating your dashboard to the v2 reporting endpoints, which return the same fields but wrap the results in a paginated envelope, so you will need to update your pagination handling as part of the move. If it would help, let us know and we can share more detail on the v2 response shape so you can plan the migration ahead of that date.
